mapper.select: SELECT ADD_TAX_TYPE, MAX(EFF_DATE) AS EFF_DATE, MAX(TAX_RATE) AS TAX_RATE FROM TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE WHERE EFF_DATE <= #{happenDate} AND SCH_ID IN ( SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} ) AND EFF_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) FROM TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE TEMP WHERE TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE.ADD_TAX_TYPE = TEMP.ADD_TAX_TYPE AND TEMP.SCH_ID IN ( SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} ) AND TEMP.EFF_DATE <= #{happenDate} ) GROUP BY ADD_TAX_TYPE

SELECT SEQ_NO, BOOKSET_ID, BOOKSET_DATE, HAPPEN_DATE, O_CCY, VAT_TYPE, TAX_P_TYPE, INCOME_AMT_ALL, TAX_AMT_SUM, TAX_AMT, BOOK_ORDER, HAPPEN_AMT, BOOK_DATE FROM TAX_BOK_BALANCE_SUM WHERE HAPPEN_DATE = #{happenDate} AND BOOK_ORDER = #{bookOrder} AND BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
